name: playable-prototype
title_zh: 一次出五个能玩的游戏原型，机器人替你按过键
tagline_zh: 别再用文字描述游戏想法了。丢进来，它给你几个方向各异的可玩原型，每个都自包含。
tagline_en: Stop describing game ideas in words. Drop one in, get several divergent, playable prototypes—each self-contained.
desc_en: Turn a game idea into several genuinely different, genuinely playable browser prototypes in one pass, each self-contained and each provably working — headlessly playtested by a bot that presses the buttons and checks the game responds. Use when asked to prototype, mock up, or spike a game or an interactive toy; to explore a mechanic in a few directions before committing; to build a small browser g
why_zh: 它不写'看起来像游戏'的静态稿，而是产出可运行原型，并让无头机器人真实交互验证。
why_en: It doesn't ship static mockups that look like games—it ships runnable prototypes, verified by a headless bot that interacts for.
limit_zh: 只产出浏览器内可玩的小型原型，不做资源打磨、不做数值平衡、不接后端存档。玩法越复杂。
limit_en: Browser-playable small prototypes only: no art polish, no balance tuning, no backend saves. The bot verifies buttons respond, not whether the game.
title_en: Five playable game prototypes per pass, bot-tested
